label: Coffee house
note: Espresso, milk and Endiro syrups. Every one can be hot or iced.

rows.name: Sticky Bun Latte
rows.desc: Espresso, milk, caramel sauce, cinnamon and hazelnut.

rows.name: Laid Back Vanilla Mocha
rows.desc: Espresso, milk, vanilla and dark chocolate.

rows.name: You Fil 'Dis Mocha?
rows.desc: Filberts (hazelnut), dark chocolate, espresso and milk.

rows.name: Oatmeal Creme Latte
rows.desc: Rolled oats, cinnamon, vanilla, espresso and milk.

rows.name: Marshmallow Latte
rows.desc: Marshmallows, whipped cream, vanilla, espresso and milk.

rows.name: Flava in 'Da Caramel and Vanilla Latte
rows.desc: Espresso, milk, caramel sauce, vanilla and a pinch of salt.

label: Breakfast
note: Every combo comes with a bottomless cup of village-lot Ugandan coffee (or black tea).

rows.name: #1 Bang Bang Chicken Muchomo and Waffles
rows.desc: Two smoky skewers of chicken and golden waffles, a pair of eggs your way, bottomless coffee or black tea.

rows.name: #2 The "Endiro Famed Breakfast"
rows.desc: Golden waffles, a pair of eggs your way, bacon or sausage, hash brown or potato wedges, bottomless coffee or black tea.

rows.name: #3 Garden Fresh Breakfast
rows.desc: Hash brown loaded with onions, tomato, spinach and mushrooms, toast, bottomless coffee or black tea, seasonal fruit salad, yogurt, Ugandan honey and muesli.

rows.name: Bacon Excitement Rolex
rows.desc: Bacon and cheddar cheese, topped with fresh guacamole and diced tomatoes.

rows.name: Greek Rolex
rows.desc: Sundried tomatoes, olives, spinach, parsley and feta cheese.

label: Lunch and dinner
note: Each entrée comes with TWO sides: rice, mashed potatoes, seasoned fries, vegetable of the day, house salad.

rows.name: Pork Ribs
rows.desc: Pork spare-ribs in Bukalasi Coffee BBQ sauce or special wet fry sauce.

rows.name: Honey Chicken
rows.desc: Deep fried honey chicken with herbs and spices.

rows.name: Creamy Pesto Chicken
rows.desc: Herbed chicken cooked with spinach and pesto in a creamy sauce.

rows.name: Coconut Fish Curry
rows.desc: Poached fish in a coconut curry.

rows.name: KLA Stir Fry
rows.desc: Steak, chicken or pork with creamy gravy and vegetables.

rows.name: Grilled Chicken or Fish Dinner
rows.desc: Butterfly-cut chicken breast or fillet of fish, grilled.
